title: Order placement failing with 503 errors
description: Customers cannot place orders. Requests to order-service hang for 30 seconds and then fail with 503. Database CPU looks normal but the application seems unable to get database connections.

title: Payment failures spiking right after release
description: Payment API is returning HTTP 500 for most card transactions. Pods are crash-looping and restarting repeatedly. The problem started shortly after a new version was rolled out.

title: Cart page extremely slow, items disappearing
description: Shopping cart loads take several seconds and items randomly vanish from carts. The in-memory key-value store used for sessions and carts appears overloaded.

title: Checkout timing out on shipping quote step
description: Checkout hangs on the shipping rate step and eventually times out. Our own pods are healthy, no recent releases. Calls to an external courier partner API seem very slow.

title: Users unable to log in, TLS errors
description: Login requests from mobile and web clients fail with secure connection errors. Clients report they cannot establish a trusted encrypted connection to the authentication endpoint.
